targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() / uniqExact(user_pseudo_id) AS events_per_user
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = '${event_name}'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
  AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)

WITH active_users AS
  (SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
   FROM analytics_events
   WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
     AND event_name = 'user_engagement'
     AND param_engagement_time_msec > 60000
     AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
     AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000))
SELECT count() / uniqExact(e.user_pseudo_id) AS events_per_active_user
FROM analytics_events e
INNER JOIN active_users a ON e.user_pseudo_id = a.user_pseudo_id
WHERE e.import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND e.event_name = '${event_name}'
  AND e.event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
  AND e.event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)

SELECT
  event_date AS TIME,
  count() AS event_count
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = '${event_name}'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
  AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
GROUP BY event_date
ORDER BY event_date

SELECT
  event_date AS TIME,
  uniqExact(user_pseudo_id) AS "Event Users"
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = '${event_name}'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
  AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
GROUP BY event_date
ORDER BY event_date

SELECT
  e.event_date AS TIME,
  uniqExact(e.user_pseudo_id) * 100.0 / a.total AS "% of All Users"
FROM analytics_events e
INNER JOIN
  (SELECT
     event_date,
     uniqExact(user_pseudo_id) AS total
   FROM analytics_events
   WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
     AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
     AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
   GROUP BY event_date) a ON e.event_date = a.event_date
WHERE e.import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND e.event_name = '${event_name}'
  AND e.event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
  AND e.event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
GROUP BY
  e.event_date,
  a.total
ORDER BY e.event_date

SELECT
  platform,
  count() AS event_count
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = '${event_name}'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
  AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
  AND platform IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY platform
ORDER BY event_count DESC

SELECT
  app_info_version,
  count() AS event_count
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_name = '${event_name}'
  AND event_date >= toDate($__from / 1000)
  AND event_date <= toDate($__to / 1000)
  AND app_info_version IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY app_info_version
ORDER BY event_count DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH
  daily_users AS (
    SELECT
      event_date,
      uniqExact(user_pseudo_id) AS total_users
    FROM analytics_events
    WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
      AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
      AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
    GROUP BY event_date
  ),
  daily_events AS (
    SELECT
      event_date,
      count() AS total_events
    FROM analytics_events
    WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
      AND event_name = '${event_name}'
      AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
      AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
    GROUP BY event_date
  )
SELECT
  daily_users.event_date AS TIME,
  ifNull(daily_events.total_events, 0) / daily_users.total_users AS "Avg"
FROM daily_users
LEFT JOIN daily_events ON daily_users.event_date = daily_events.event_date
ORDER BY TIME
